body: I’m in the same boat but archdruid. Interested to see what folks have to say.

author: arusinoff
body:
Bear's might buff would help a lot.
Since your horse is using Att as main stat, and you are sharing all buffs - buffing up your Att and Crit stat with all possible ways would make Horse attack even higher.

Also, it's a good idea to start collecting gear with Ward, and use Ward skills for survivability. With that, you will have to start upgrading your gear and shield. Weapon with ward would be good as well.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
You definitely want bear's might. Your own +stat boosts affect your follower too, so it's very worthwhile.

War Horse is the better option, in my opinion. More monsters are immune or resistant to dark than physical. Lindwyrm is good for raiding, but overall far less consistent and satisfying. You also can't use it for dungeons, really.

Your gear is decent, though I'd aim to get better armor. If you can stay alive longer in raids by spamming defend/potions, you'll eventually win, so defensiveness is worthwhile.

author: petr1petr
body:
your stats and boosts affect your pet, so buff according to your pet - if it is melee, go with melee weapon and melee buffs.

class and spec is OK (dont switch to summoner, it is easy, but your brains will die and you will be lost once you reach T10)

equips - there are few ways you can go - pet power - or by having items that give bonus to pets (kerberos items) or by having items that boost your atk/mag. another way is to build strong def/res/ward and simply survive while the pet does its job. 

horse id fine.

if you have time, go to youtube and find Shabbash - watch his guide for pet classline
